tasks.title: The setpoint in the Actual model
tasks.statement: A profile with `rates_type = ACTUAL`: `roll_rc_rate = {rc}`, `roll_srate = {sr}`, `roll_expo = {ex}`. The roll stick is deflected by **{x}** of travel to the right. Find the roll setpoint in °/s.
tasks.solution: C = rc_rate·10, M = srate·10, e = expo/100. `applyActualRates`: rate = C·x + (M − C)·|x|·(x⁵·e + x·(1 − e)). The center and the maximum are set directly, and expo changes only the shape between them.

tasks.title: The maximum rate of the Betaflight model
tasks.statement: The BETAFLIGHT model: RC rate **{r}**, super rate **{s}**, expo 0.30. Find the maximum angular rate at full stick, °/s.
tasks.solution: At x = 1 the expo term gives x' = 1, and the super factor is 1/(1 − s). Maximum = 200·r/(1 − s). Expo affects the center (×(1 − e)) but not the maximum; RC rate ≤ 2.0, so the RC_RATE_INCREMENTAL correction is not needed.

tasks.title: The automatic RC smoothing cutoff
tasks.statement: Betaflight 2025.12 measured a receiver rate of **{f} Hz**, `rc_smoothing_auto_factor = {a}`, `rc_smoothing_setpoint_cutoff = 0`. What setpoint cutoff (the “Active setpoint and FF cutoff” line) will `rc_smoothing_info` show, Hz?
tasks.solution: `rcSmoothingSetFilterCutoffs`: cutoff = max(15, (uint16)(f_rx·1.5/(1 + factor/10))). The fractional part is dropped, and the lower bound is 15 Hz. The formula is the same in 4.5 and 2025.12.

tasks.title: A channel after rxrange
tasks.statement: `rxrange 0 {lo} {hi}` is set for roll. The receiver outputs **{v} µs**. Find the channel value after scaling (rcData), µs.
tasks.solution: `applyRxChannelRangeConfiguraton` calls scaleRangef(v, min, max, 1000, 2000): rcData = 1000 + (v − min)·1000/(max − min). Only channels 0–3 after `map` are scaled.

tasks.title: Two Actual profiles at the same stick deflection
tasks.statement: Profile A is the default `ACTUAL 7/67/0` (70/670/0). Profile B is `roll_rc_rate = {rc}`, `roll_srate = {sr}`, `roll_expo = {ex}`. The roll stick is deflected by **{x}** of travel. By how many °/s is the setpoint of profile B greater than that of A (B − A; if B is slower, the answer is negative)?
tasks.solution: `applyActualRates` (4.5.3 `fc/rc.c:209`): rate = C·x + (M − C)·|x|·(x⁵·e + x·(1 − e)), C = rc_rate·10, M = srate·10, e = expo/100. For A (e = 0): 70·x + 600·x². Example: B = 20/85/20 at x = 0.5 gives 100 + 650·0.203125 = 232.0 °/s, A — 185 °/s, a difference of +47.0 °/s.

tasks.title: The feedforward jitter multiplier in 4.5.3
tasks.statement: Betaflight 4.5.3, `feedforward_jitter_factor = {j}`. An ELRS link at **{f} Hz**, the roll stick moves uniformly at **{v}** units of `rcCommand` per second (from center to stop — 500 units, full travel — 1000). What value will `debug_mode = FEEDFORWARD_LIMIT` show in the field debug[0] (the jitter multiplier × 100, %)?
tasks.solution: The step per packet is Δ = v/f, and the previous one is the same. `rc.c:535`: at Δ < j the multiplier = 1 − (1 − (Δ + Δprev)/(2j))² = 1 − (1 − Δ/j)², and at Δ ≥ j it is 1 (100 %). Example: 1500 units/s at 500 Hz — Δ = 3, j = 7: 1 − (4/7)² = 0.673 → 67 %. In 2025.12 the formula is different: min(1, (Δ + 1)/(1 + j)).
